title: MoU signed with Bauniabadh Model High School
summary: Kolpojontro Foundation and Bauniabadh Model High School signed an agreement to expand Pathshala activities.
content: To expand the reach of Pathshala, Kolpojontro Foundation signed a formal MoU with Bauniabadh Model High School. Under this partnership, students will receive regular science and technology-based vocational training.
Through this collaboration, Kolpojontro volunteers will deliver hands-on ICT sessions, practical science learning, and activities focused on creative skill development.
Both organizations expect the initiative to improve confidence, practical capability, and long-term opportunities for underprivileged students.

title: Pathshala now includes Kalidesh Kolim Uddin High School, Tangail
summary: A new Pathshala program has started at Kalidesh Kolim Uddin High School in Tangail.
content: As part of Pathshala expansion, Kalidesh Kolim Uddin High School in Tangail has been onboarded. This new partnership brings technology-oriented learning opportunities to more students.
The program plan includes foundational computer literacy, digital awareness, and practical science sessions tailored to student needs.
With participation from teachers and guardians, the initiative will be implemented through a collaborative local model for long-term sustainability.

title: Talimuddin Madrasa in Dhaka joined under Project Pathshala
summary: Pathshala vocational training has been extended to Talimuddin Madrasa in Dhaka.
content: Talimuddin Madrasa in Dhaka has joined Kolpojontro Foundation’s Pathshala project. The goal is to include madrasa students in practical science and technology learning opportunities.
The training team will run sessions on ICT skills, problem-solving ability, and modern learning practices that students can apply in real life.
Kolpojontro believes this integrated approach will strengthen self-reliance and build applicable skills for students’ future.
